selectedCount: {n, plural, =0 {No cards selected} one {# card selected} other {# cards selected}}
addModeHelp: Click: choose quantity, condition, language and version, then add. Card + button: +1 to the selection. Right-click: remove the card. Ctrl+drag toggles the cards it covers: unselected ones are selected, selected ones are removed. The page scrolls at the screen edge. Ctrl+A: select all. Alt+click one card, then click or Alt+click another: selects every number between them, e.g. #001 to #005a without taking #005b.
addModeHelpTouch: Tap a card to choose the quantity, condition, language and version. The card’s + button adds one copy to the selection; “Select all” takes every card shown.
rangeStart: Range start: #{number}. Click the end card.
missingTotalPartial: Total price of missing cards: {total} (excluding {unpriced} without a price)
leaveBody: {count} {noun} have not been added to the collection. Leaving add mode clears this selection.
